rationale: The plan correctly identifies the perfect confound, refuses to fit a batch term or apply ComBat-seq/SVA, and uses design ~condition with Control as explicit reference, matching the reference exactly; every result is explicitly caveated as batch-inseparable. QC (blind VST/PCA/heatmap/library size colored by condition and batch) precedes testing with a clear policy statement. Filtering, DESeq2-internal size factors/edgeR TMM normalization, apeglm shrinkage, and BH-FDR at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering are all correctly specified. GSEA is reasonably justified as more batch-robust than gene-level calls with full ranked list, stated ranking metric, named collections/versions, and size window, though running enrichment at all under a perfect confound is debatable (hence not a perfect 10) and version pinning ("Hallmark 2026.1") is vague/unverified. The final report is exhaustive, naming versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and caveats as required.
